metadata.name: Type into a web page
metadata.author: recued-core
metadata.description: Use “Type into a web page” in Recued. Fill a field on a page by its ref or its name: text replaces what it holds, a list takes an option, a checkbox true or false; pick chooses a suggestion. Asks you first, unless you've allowed it on that site, naming the field and the whole text. Types nothing if the page changed since inspected. Answers what changed.

ref.help: The ref of the element, such as e12, from the latest inspection of this page. Leave it empty when naming it by its text.
ref.label: Element

page.help: The page handle from List browser tabs, Open a web page, a read, or what a click or Act on web pages answered, copied exactly; not an address. A page that has reloaded or gone to another address has a new handle: a click or Act that loaded it answers it, so use that; else read the page by its address for it.
page.label: Page

pick.help: For a field that suggests as you type (a city, a contact, a company): the text of the suggestion to choose, such as London, UK. The value is typed, then the suggestion with this text is clicked and the field checked to hold it. Leave it empty for a field that takes what is typed.
pick.label: Suggestion to pick

text.help: Or what the element shows or is called on the page, as an inspection names it, such as Search Wikipedia or Sign in. Leave it empty when passing a ref.
text.label: Element by its text

value.help: What to enter. Text replaces what the field holds. A list takes an option's value or visible text, one per line for a list that allows several. A checkbox or radio button takes true or false.
value.label: Value
